scoring_context.note: Scores measure present TITMAS fit, not the intrinsic quality of an upstream project. Version and security facts must be refreshed before implementation.

components.maintenance_activity: Active; supported majors receive regular bug and security fixes
components.known_security_advisories: Official security page and 18.4 release notes checked; historical advisories exist; no assertion that every deployment is unaffected
components.dependency_count: No separate runtime service dependency; operating-system libraries and extensions vary
components.minimum_memory: Not fixed by upstream; workload benchmark required
components.minimum_storage: Not fixed by upstream; ledger retention and backup sizing required
components.data_access_required: Canonical TITMAS transactional and tenant-scoped records
components.network_access_required: Local private network only for current baseline
components.upgrade_strategy: Pin supported major/minor; backup, restore rehearsal and release-note review before upgrade
components.rollback_strategy: Application rollback plus database backup/restore; never claim schema downgrade without a tested path
components.replacement_boundary: SQL repository layer and migrations; TITMAS semantics remain outside PostgreSQL
